exclusion_detail: Radiolabelling paper: the lead is the carbon-11 tracer [11C]-2, made by [11C]CH3I methylation of its desmethyl precursor from cyclotron [11C]CO2; the paper's featured synthesis is the radiolabelling.

lead.label: [11C]-2
lead.why: Abstract: '3-Acetyl-4-(1-[11C]-methyl-1H-indol-3-yl)[1H]pyrrole-2,5-dione ([11C]-2) was obtained by direct methylation using [11C]-CH3I'; it is the tracer taken into biodistribution and PET imaging.

notes: I did not look into the cold (unlabelled) synthesis of 2 or its precursor, since the lead rule picks the radiolabelled compound.
